news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, with the agency aligning on the planned content and format of the submission. The company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit the NDA in late Q4 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Abivax S.A. (ABVX.US) With Buy Rating, Raises Target Price to $180
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reiterated its Overweight/Buy rating on Abivax and lifted its price target to $180 from $132, citing growing confidence in obefazimod's regulatory path and commercial prospects in ulcerative colitis.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four senior commercial executives (heads of marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access), several with prior Amgen/Takeda experience, as it builds a standalone U.S. commercial organization ahead of the planned obefazimod NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: In a CNBC interview, Abivax's CEO said the company's newly raised $920 million gives it the firepower to launch obefazimod independently in the U.S. rather than pursue a sale, pushing back on ongoing takeover speculation.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized, oversubscribed ADS offering priced at $125 per share, raising roughly $874 million in net proceeds and extending its cash runway into Q4 2029 to fund the obefazimod launch.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Full Exercise of Underwriters' Option to Purchase Additional ADSs, Bringing Gross Proceeds of Offering to $920M (€807M)
news.summary: Underwriters fully exercised their option on Abivax's public offering, lifting total shares sold to 7.36 million ADSs and total gross proceeds to $920 million, up from the initial $800 million upsized deal priced July 1.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis; a positive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026 confirmed alignment on content/format.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA submission (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for filing a Marketing Authorization Application with the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to report first-half 2026 financial results and provide a business update, including cash runway and regulatory progress.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. commercial launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Following the recently built-out commercial leadership team and the $920M raise (runway into Q4 2029), Abivax is preparing for a standalone U.S. launch if/when obefazimod is approved.

catalysts.label: M&A / takeover speculation
catalysts.detail: Reports earlier in 2026 linked Eli Lilly to a potential ~€15bn takeover of Abivax; no formal offer has been confirmed, and the CEO has emphasized a path to going it alone after the large capital raise.

pulse: Abivax enters the second half of 2026 well-capitalized and de-risked on the regulatory front: a $920M ADS offering closed in early July extended cash runway into Q4 2029, and a positive July 30 pre-NDA meeting with the FDA kept the company on track for a late-Q4 2026 NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, alongside a planned H2 2026 EU MAA filing. New commercial leadership hires signal the company is building toward an independent U.S. launch rather than a sale, even as persistent takeover chatter (previously involving Eli Lilly) and lingering investor caution over a cancer signal flagged in the maintenance-trial data (from earlier in 2026) remain overhangs. Near-term watch items are the H1 2026 results update (expected September) and any further FDA/EMA regulatory milestones ahead of the year-end NDA submission.
